title: Find records, pages and how-to guides
summary: Use one search to locate permitted records and instructions.
keywords: search wiki readme library help recipient beneficiary payroll
prerequisites: Sign in to the admin portal with permission to open Operations overview.
Use your assigned operational role; documentation does not grant additional authority.

steps.title: Confirm your workspace
steps.instruction: Check the signed-in account. In Business also verify the selected business name before searching.

steps.title: Enter a search
steps.instruction: Use the header field or Ctrl+K (Command+K on macOS). Type at least two characters of a reference, name, currency or task.

steps.title: Inspect matches
steps.instruction: Suggestions combine records, pages and guides. Use Tab to reach an item and Escape to close suggestions.

steps.title: See all matches
steps.instruction: Press Enter or choose View all results. Select a category to page through its matches. Exact identifiers and references rank first.

steps.title: Open the result
steps.instruction: Transfers and batches use their existing detail routes. Other records open an authorized metadata summary with a source-module link.

steps.title: Read without leaving a form
steps.instruction: Use the header Help button for this page or choose Help & Guides in the sidebar for the full library.

expectedResult: Results, counts and guides relate only to the current account and permitted business context.
warnings: A search summary is not a payment confirmation. Search does not submit any financial action.
Credentials, raw provider payloads, identity documents and bank account numbers are not included.
troubleshooting: No matches: try the exact reference, a shorter name or another category. Use the source module for a record type not covered by this search.
An unavailable or timeout response is not a zero-result search. Retry an exact reference or a single category.
Changing account or business clears displayed results; access is checked again when a record is opened.

title: Manage account security and browser-wide sign-in
summary: Inspect your account, MFA recovery and active sessions.
keywords: mfa 2fa login recovery security sessions password
prerequisites: Sign in to the admin portal with permission to open Account and security.
Use your assigned operational role; documentation does not grant additional authority.

steps.title: Open your account
steps.instruction: Choose Account & security from the account menu. Confirm the name, email and access roles displayed.

steps.title: Review MFA
steps.instruction: Read Multi-factor authentication, its enabled/required state and the remaining recovery-code count.

steps.title: Use the intended action
steps.instruction: Choose Generate new recovery codes or Reset your authenticator only when needed. Complete Current password, verification method and the requested authenticator or recovery code.

steps.title: Secure new recovery codes
steps.instruction: After generating codes, use Copy codes or Download .txt, store them privately and choose I saved them. Previous recovery codes are invalidated.

steps.title: Review signed-in sessions
steps.instruction: Use the session controls to sign out an unwanted device or other sessions. Inspect the updated list.

steps.title: Use another browser tab
steps.instruction: A new protected tab at the same application address reuses the current browser-profile login. Logging out or changing account invalidates the older account state in other tabs.

expectedResult: Account security and session changes are reflected by the existing security screen.
warnings: This screen does not introduce a password-change or transaction-PIN form. Use only the controls actually displayed.
Different browser profiles and private browsing sessions have separate storage. Never share passwords, bearer tokens or recovery codes.
troubleshooting: A missing or disabled action can indicate insufficient permission, unavailable configuration or an incompatible record status. Check the current account and selected record; do not bypass the restriction.
Correct the field errors shown. After an uncertain submission, refresh the record before trying again to avoid duplicate operations.
